-- Drop if exists
IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.demo_table_5') IS NOT NULL
    DROP TABLE dbo.demo_table_5;
GO

-- Create 10 million dummy rows
CREATE TABLE dbo.demo_table_5
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
    HEAP
)
AS
WITH Numbers AS (
    SELECT TOP (10000)
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS n
    FROM sys.all_objects
)
SELECT TOP (20000000)
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) * 10 AS col_int,
    (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL))) % 32767 AS col_smallint,
    CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) * 1.1 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS col_dec,
    CONCAT('name_', ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL))) AS col_vc,
    CASE WHEN (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL))) % 2 = 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS col_flag,
    '2000-01-01' AS col_date,
    '2000-01-01T00:00:00' AS col_dt,
    (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL))) * 100 AS col_bigint,
    GETDATE() AS col_datetime
FROM Numbers AS a
CROSS JOIN Numbers AS b
CROSS JOIN Numbers AS c;
GO
